subject: PoC de-risk & evaluation plan — QuantumHealth

Subject: PoC de-risk & evaluation plan — QuantumHealth

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed, lightweight PoC plan to make the evaluation low-risk and high-signal. I captured success criteria you mentioned on the call and added a few things we typically see in similar health-tech pilots. Please review and flag anything missing.

Proposed PoC objectives (3 weeks):
- Validate end-to-end latency and throughput for typical clinical query mix (50–200 tokens) under production-like concurrency.
- Confirm inference cost per 1k requests within your target (target: <$0.08/request net after batching).
- Demonstrate data controls (KV cache TTL, redact PII before logging) and proof of audit logs delivery to your SIEM.

Minimal evaluation plan / milestones:
1) Kickoff (Week 0): technical onboarding and security checklist — owners: Marcus + Emily — target: 3 business days after SOW sign-off.
2) Week 1: Baseline runs with synthetic and replay traffic, initial latency/cost readouts — owner: Marcus.
3) Week 2: Integration tests with your staging data (anonymized), evaluate inference accuracy on sample prompts and business metrics — owners: Emily + Lauren.
4) Week 3: Final readout, executive summary, and recommendations (include cost/throughput tradeoffs and suggested quantization/ batching config).

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to send a 1-page tech checklist and preferred kickoff dates (we recommend Mon 7/19 or Tue 7/20).
- Emily to share the security_requirements.pdf and any internal compliance constraints (retention, KMS, IP allowances).
- I will prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) doc and a one-page SOW for review.

Attachments: I will attach a draft MAP (placeholder) after Marcus confirms the kickoff window.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a quick hands-on trial.

— Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Lauren — this looks sensible and aligned with what we discussed. A couple clarifications and our must-have success criteria: 

QuantumHealth must-haves for PoC:
- No patient-identifiable data leaves our VPC during the trial; logs must be configurable and forward to our Splunk instance.
- Latency: 95th pct < 300ms for average clinical prompt size (we will provide prompt sample set).
- Inference answers should maintain our accuracy threshold: match ground truth labels on our evaluation set at >= 88% F1 for the three primary intent classes.

We will send the security_requirements.pdf (attached) — it includes KMS integration expectations and an initial SOC checklist. We can run a small anonymized sample (5k queries) in staging.

Kickoff: we prefer Mon 7/19. Can Marcus and the team confirm availability?

Also, we need a simple MAP that calls out roles, timeline, and signoffs. If you can get that to us by EOD Monday 7/13 that would help us secure internal approvals.

Thanks,
Emily

Hi all —

We can absolutely meet the constraints Emily outlined. A few technical assumptions and asks so we don't hit roadblocks in Week 1: 

Assumptions / needs:
- Network: a short-lived VPC peering or secure tunnel; we'll ship logs to your Splunk via an S3 delivery + Lambda forwarder (works with your KMS).
- Test data: please share the anonymized prompt set and the expected labels CSV (5k rows). We will not store raw inputs beyond the PoC timeframe (we can set TTL = 7 days).
- Peak concurrency for tests: please confirm whether we should emulate 5 QPS or 20 QPS — we'll size the pool accordingly.

Proposed kickoff agenda (45–60m):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Security and network checklist review (10m)
- Inference config walk-through and sample workload generation (15m)
- Timeline and success criteria sign-off (10m)
- Q&A and next steps (10m)

I attached a sample inference_config.yml with our recommended defaults for batching, KV cache TTL, and candidate model variants.

Availability: Marcus is free Mon 7/19 morning (9–11am ET) or Tue 7/20 afternoon (1–4pm ET). Please confirm and we'll calendar the kickoff.
